analysis:
Examined CHANGELOG.md base_text units covering lines 4067-4538, which are historical release notes for v0.9.x and are unchanged by this PR. The file_changes map, with range_map_complete=true, shows the only changes at base 11-13 and head 11-39. Those changes rename the candidate to v0.10.10 and add notes on the waitlist feature, the units do not include those lines, and they are documentation only.

The changed prose describes new waitlist approval gating for `darkbloom sandbox setup` (TB-013, T-061, A-019) and for new `darkbloom cluster` pairs. Per the excerpt, `darkbloom cluster local` needs no approval, existing installs are grandfathered, and setup fails open ('go on as in 0.10.9') when the coordinator does not offer waitlists. That fail-open is an availability and product gate, not a security control in the threat model, since approval is not described as an installer integrity check. The next pass should confirm in source that waitlist approval does not replace or weaken installer integrity checks (T-061) or the GPU-limit confirmation and administrator prompt (TB-014, T-062).

The historical lines in these units mention cache TTL and disk budget (T-041) and App Attest behaviors (TB-011). They are not changed here, so no regression is attributable to them. No source code is visible in this batch, so this is a coverage limit only.
